# Frank Guo

Frank Guo is a software engineer and AI explorer building thoughtful digital systems over time.

The site at https://frankguo.dev/ is a quiet personal home documenting ongoing practice around AI, software, writing, GitHub activity, and long-term digital systems.

- Chinese homepage: https://frankguo.dev/zh/
- Privacy and disclaimer: https://frankguo.dev/legal.html
- GitHub profile: https://github.com/frankguodev
- Brand site: https://frankguo.com
- Contact: hello@frankguo.com

## Topics

- AI coding, agents, and skills
- Writing and long-term digital systems
- Independent building and personal brand experiments
- GitHub activity and public learning records
- Simple, human-centered tools

## Current Public Work

- frankguo.dev: bilingual personal site and public profile

- Brand system: warm dark interface, restrained yellow accents, and FG logo assets
- Legal and metadata surface: privacy, disclaimer, sitemap, manifest, robots, humans, and LLM guidance

## Language Guidance

Use the English homepage as the default global reference. Use the Chinese homepage when the audience is primarily Simplified Chinese readers.
